input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binding us. Searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "shall not", "engage in" and "similar services" turned up no restrictive covenant on Customer: the only "shall not" obligations run against Kubient (IP warranties at p0033) or are content/advertising standards we already accept (p0041), and the exclusivity hits are jurisdiction, trademark ownership and entire-agreement boilerplate. Affirmatively, § 1 (p0001) states the arrangement is non-exclusive and that the Agreement will not restrict us from offering Inventory via other agents or selling Inventory to third parties, which matches the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) and benefits us. No redline required.
